secrets.title: Title of the dialog that lists connections to secret managers (Vault, AWS, 1Password and similar).
secrets.add: Button that starts a new connection.
secrets.edit: Button or title for changing a connection.
secrets.confirmRemove: {{alias}} is the name the person gave the connection.
secrets.turnedOn: State of the switch of a connection. Very short.
secrets.turnedOff: State of the switch of a connection. Very short.
secrets.switchLabel: Accessible label of the on/off switch. {{alias}} is the connection name.
secrets.alias: Label of the field for the name of a connection.
secrets.aliasPlaceholder: Example connection name shown in an empty field.
secrets.kind: Label of the field that picks the type of secret manager.
secrets.colour: Label of the colour picker for a connection.
secrets.credentialStored: Placeholder of a password field when a credential is already saved.
secrets.testTitle: Heading of the section that reads one secret as a test.
secrets.desktopOnlyTitle: Heading of a notice shown in the web app.
secrets.kinds: Product names of secret managers. Keep them as they are.
secrets.kindFields: Field labels that replace the general ones for one service.
secrets.kindHints: Setup help for one service. Keep product, command and menu names (op, bw, bws, Settings, Developer) as written.
secrets.fields.mount: Vault concept: the path where a secrets engine is mounted.
secrets.fields.roleId: Vault AppRole login identifier. Keep AppRole.
secrets.fields.secretId: Vault AppRole login secret. Keep AppRole.
secrets.fields.authority: Address of the service that signs a person in (Azure authority).
secrets.fields.command: Name or path of a program that is run. Placeholder says it is found automatically.
secrets.placeholders.command: Placeholder of the program field: the program is looked up on the system path.
secrets.placeholders.sessionKey: Keep the command bw unlock --raw unchanged.
secrets.pairing.keepassxc.label: Label of the row that shows the connection with KeePassXC.
secrets.pairing.keepassxc.connect: Button that pairs Gostman with KeePassXC.
secrets.pairing.keepassxc.prompt: Keep the KeePassXC button name Save and allow access as it appears in KeePassXC.
secrets.pairing.keepassxc.paired: {{name}} is the name KeePassXC stores for this connection.
secrets.unlocking.bitwarden.note: Keep the commands bw unlock written as they are.
secrets.unlocking.bitwarden.unlocked: Select Save is the Save button of the dialog.
reference.offOption: Entry in a connection list for a connection that is switched off. {{alias}} is its name.
reference.missingConnection: {{alias}} is the name of a connection that does not exist here.
reference.connectionOff: {{alias}} is the name of a connection that is switched off.
reference.manager: Label of the choice of secret manager for a variable.
reference.useManager: Button or menu entry that makes a variable read its value from a secret manager.
reference.usePlain: Button or menu entry that makes a variable hold a typed value.
reference.path: Label of the field for the location of a secret inside the manager.
reference.field: Label of the field that picks one key from a JSON secret.
reference.fieldPlaceholder: Placeholder meaning the field can be left empty.
reference.fieldNames: Label of the field in password managers where an entry has several fields.
reference.fieldPlaceholders: Example values: the first is the usual field name for a password.
reference.version: Label of the optional version field of a secret.
reference.test: Button that reads the secret once to check the settings.
reference.testing: Status text while the test runs.
reference.worked: Result of a successful test: only the length of the secret is shown, never its value.
reference.noConnections: Hint shown when no connection exists yet.
reference.unknownConnection: {{alias}} is the name of a connection that does not exist here.
reference.paths: Example paths for each service. Keep them as examples; translate only the words that describe an item, for example the last two entries.
reference.versions: Placeholders for the version field, which means different things for each service.
secrets.save: Button that saves the secret manager connection. Verb.
secrets.close: Button that closes the secret manager dialog. Verb.
secrets.fields.token: Label of the field for an access token.
